summary: Repair the final-artifact PC-F contract drift on exact accepted AlembicCore@c0a6633d. The controller's v5 rebuild proved that exactly one frozen row changed: dist/projectContextFoundation.js no longer matches PCFBaselineReceipt because Core@96655b9 added createProjectContextFileRef to the project-context-foundation aggregator, and Alembic@602be240 now consumes that route. In AlembicCore only, expose createProjectContextFileRef from the existing @alembic/core/project-context public facade, remove only the later project-context-foundation re-export, and update the public boundary/tests needed for that deliberate route. After build, the five PCFBaselineReceipt files must recompute exactly to sha256:4d3ecdc70227cd3cc613c9df26ca04107a6327aec7eebc5eae3a5856c614f008; @alembic/core/project-context must import the function through the built package and project-context-foundation must return to its frozen export surface. Preserve all accepted production/V5 cross-harvest semantics and package exports, do not modify Agent/Main/Plugin/Test/Wakeflow, and return one clean Core commit with parent/tree, diff, focused baseline/public-import/V5 regressions, full repository check, Guard, risks and the exact downstream interface for the subsequent Main import migration. It is expected that current Main remains a pending consumer until a separate post-acceptance Alembic package; do not patch it or claim the final artifact gate complete.
